commit.message:
FM2-712: Fix Practitioner search by name, given, family and address (#644)

* FM2-712: Fix Practitioner search by name, given, family and address

PractitionerSearchParams now registers name, given and family with
their property names, and the address parameters under
ADDRESS_SEARCH_HANDLER with theirs, the same way PatientSearchParams
and PersonSearchParams do.

BasePractitionerDao passes these to BasePersonDao.handleNames and
handleAddresses, which switch on the property name. Without one,
handleNames threw a NullPointerException, so any name, given or family
search returned a 500. The address parameters went under the per-field
CITY_, STATE_, POSTALCODE_ and COUNTRY_SEARCH_HANDLER keys, which
BasePractitionerDao doesn't handle, so they were ignored. Both came in
with FM2-481, which moved these parameters out of
FhirPractitionerServiceImpl.

The existing PractitionerSearchQueryTest cases build the
SearchParameterMap by hand in the right form, so they never exercised
toSearchParameterMap(). The new cases go through
PractitionerSearchParams, and two R4 integration tests cover the HTTP
searches.

* Test each Practitioner address parameter on its own

Each address parameter now has its own test with a matching and a
non-matching value, built through PractitionerSearchParams. These
replace the wrong-city test.

The combined address test sets all four parameters at once, so it stayed
green if state, postal code or country went back under its old key: the
other three still narrowed the result to one provider. Moving any one
key back now fails that parameter's test.

commit.message:
Replace xml-patch with a custom implementation

xml-patch introduces a few common security risks often present when
handling XML. Worse, the library provides no mechanism to provide a
secure implementation. Fixing this with internal Java XML libraries is
under 600 LOC, so it's implemented here instead.
